verdicts.reason: A rearranges the design well (bottle in its circle as the hero, then headline, then the NEW + Try It row), but the headline is left-offset (starts ~x=85) and is not centred on the axis the bottle and buttons share. The headline is also fairly small for the square, and the lone faint circle in the top left looks like a stray. B pushes the bottle into the top-left corner with its cap almost touching the canvas edge and its decorative circle cropped. The NEW pill is blown up to nearly CTA size so the two compete, the stacked right-aligned buttons leave the bottom left dead, and the product is shrunk to an afterthought next to the oversized headline.
